newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-BOSNIA-CROATIA CLASH MOVED FORWARD ONE DAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOSNIA-CROATIA CLASH MOVED FORWARD ONE DAY.

text.p: The World Cup qualifier between former Balkan war enemies Bosnia and Croatia has been moved forward a day to October 8, FIFA said on Friday.

The Group One match, which will be played on the neutral ground of Renato dall'Ara Stadium in Bologna, Italy, was brought forward to avoid clashing with a Group Two qualifier between Italy and Georgia in Perugia.
Bosnia had hoped to stage their first home qualifier in Sarajevo but FIFA ruled their stadium was not yet up to standard after being damaged during the fighting.
The Under-21 European championship qualifier between Bosnia and Croatia to be played in Imola was also moved forward one day to October 8.
